name: Korea Gas Corporation
summary: Korea Gas Corporation engages in the exploration, development, production, import, and wholesale of liquefied natural gas (LNG), compressed natural gas, and natural gas in Korea, Australia, Iraq, Mozambique, and Myanmar. It operates through the Natural Gas Wholesale and Others segments.
